start.text: I buy at wholesale and keep the customers. A warehouse leaves the customers and margin with you, but you fund sea freight, duty, storage and slow stock. A video call works if you cannot afford a flight.

choices.text: Show me the costs and risks.
I will compare before committing cash.

costs.text: Use the actual company books, not revenue alone. Stock and money on the way still tie up cash.

wait.text: Waiting is a choice too. Watch the deadlines, fees and stock before you decide.
